lawyer: Hasan Foez Siddique with AKM Moniruzzaman (Kabir), Advocates-For the Petitioner No one ----- For the Opposite Parties.
parties:
Binode Bihari Ghose ------ Plaintiff-Petitioner
vs.  
Assistant Custodian, Vested and Non-Resident Property and others ------ Defendant-Opposite Parties
full_judgment:
3. Plaintiffs case is that, Pulin Behari Paul sold 0.26 acres of land to the plaintiff by a registered kabala dated 7-6-79. Thereafter sold 0.26½ acre of land to the plaintiff by another registered kabala dated 2-8-79 and lastly, sold 0.74½ acre of land to the plaintiff by a registered kabala dated 18-2-80. Thus the plaintiff purchased 1.27 acre of land from Pulin Bihari Paul. It is stated that plots and khatians have been correctly written in all the above three deeds. But in two of the deeds namely, deeds dated 7-6-79 and 2-8-79 owing to the mistake of the deed writer the name of mouza was wrongly written as Baukhola Mouza instead of 'Islamkati Mouza'. It has further been stated in the plaint that in the SA Khatian the suit land was in the name of the Pulin Bihari Paul, the vendor of the plaintiff. And after the said purchase plaintiffs name was duly mutated in the record of right and since then he had been regularly paying rent to the Government. The plaintiff thereafter came to know that the defendant No.1, the Assistant Custodian of Enemy Property had been trying to lease out the suit property to someone as vested property for which he was constrained to file the aforesaid suit. 

 6. PWs 1 has stated in his evidence that Pulin Behari Paul's name was rightly recorded in the SA Khatian and after purchase the plaintiff has had his name duly mutated in the Government khatian and since then has been paying rent regularly and exhibited the dakhilas. 

 7. PW 1 has further stated in his deposition that although he purchased 0.26 acre from khatian Nos. 977, 978 and 0.19½ acres from khatian No. 117 of 'Islam Kathi Mouza' it was wrongly written as' Baukhola Mouza' in Kabala deeds dated 7-6-79 and 2-8-79 and PW 1 was corroborated by other PWs. 

 9. On consideration of the evidence oral and documentary the learned trial Court found that Pulin Behari never left for India, SA Khatian of the suit land stood in the name of Pulin Behari he executed and registered the aforesaid deeds in favour of the plaintiff. 

 17. Admittedly the suit land belonged to Pulin Behari Paul and SA Khatian was rightly prepared in his name. 

 18. Both the Courts have concurrently found that all the aforesaid registered kabalas were duly executed by the vendor Pulin Behari Paul, in favour of the plaintiff, on receipt of proper consideration and the possession thereof was delivered to the plaintiff and since then the plaintiff has been possessing the suit land and has had his name mutated in the SA Khatian and has been paying rent regularly. 

 19. The Courts below on consideration of the evidence oral and documentary observed that at Baukhola Mouza, there were no such khatians as khatian numbers 977 or 978 and also found that at the relevant time Pulin Behari had no land at Baukhola Mouza. 

 25. Both the courts have on detailed consideration of evidence documentary and oral, concurrently found that 'Baukhola Mouza' was wrongly written in the deeds, in place of Islam Kati Mouza; the sale had been duly acted upon; the suit land had been delivered to the plaintiff; he had his name mutated in the Government Khatian and had been paying rent to the Government regularly.
